Hi Sanjay, Rachel —

Thanks for agreeing to run the joint co-sell/demo for Acme. To make the live session smooth we need to lock (a) the production demo slot and (b) a short facilitator rehearsal to walk through transitions and slide handoffs.

Proposed demo windows (all times PT):
- Option A: Wed Jun 2, 09:00–10:30 PT (best for EMEA overlap)
- Option B: Wed Jun 2, 11:00–12:30 PT (better for APAC handoffs)
- Option C: Thu Jun 3, 08:00–09:30 PT (alternate if conflicts)

Ask: can you confirm which window works for Acme and who will lead the customer-use-case portion (CloudPulse) vs vendor segment (AWS)? We suggest Redwood owns the runtime demo and the final Q&A.

Plan / quick asks:
- 15-min pre-call rehearsal the same morning (we propose 30–45 min before demo).
- Facilitator roles: primary presenter, SI deep-dive owner, cloud procurement owner.
- Please confirm any AV or SSO constraints (Acme uses Okta).

I've attached the initial runbook and the latest slides for context (see attachments). Once we lock a slot I'll send a calendar invite and a short runbook update with clear slide-to-slide handoffs.

Attachments: crosscloud-runbook-v1.docx, demo-slides-v2.pdf

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
